sentences.text: Rannikon Ilmastointi ja Kylmä OY is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-03 under the industry code 43220, plumbing, heat and air-conditioning installation.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-03, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-14.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a coastal word but the registered industry is installation work.
